justification: Assessment reported INVALID at step 0040 and its stated defect is the zero-exponent case: the proof declares the p=0/q=0 case resolved without proving any inequality, while the domain it hands to the next stage (R_{>=0}) still contains p=0, which is exactly where the following construction phi(x)=x^{q/p} (steps 0042-0043) breaks down. The ground truth flaw is that phi(x)=x^{q/p} is not well-defined in the zero-exponent case (witness p=0, q=1, x=1: exponent 1/0 undefined). Both target the same defect - the p=0 case is illegitimately folded into the Jensen/convexity argument that presupposes a real exponent q/p - so this is the same claim with a different-but-valid framing. The assessment also correctly notes the theorem itself is true, hence no counterexample to the statement, matching the ground truth witness being a witness against the step, not the theorem.
